risk_note: RV2 (device registration risk; BR-ID-05 per-IP hourly registration cap, BR-ID-09 hot device_hash monitoring). Redis Lua sorted-set reservation per (app_id, IP blind index) with a closed sliding window from the injected Clock, 42901 + Retry-After without issuing a device_id; the invalid-hash check (20001) runs before the reservation; explicit insert failures release the slot, unknown outcomes are reconciled under the same transaction-level advisory lock as the insert (lock timeout or error keeps the slot); Redis unavailable or absent refuses with 42901; hot device_hash counter alerts once per 24 h window and never blocks; thresholds through the B1-03e config port. Client IP is Fastify request.ip as in B1-03e (trustProxy tracked by B1-03m). Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
